name: nhtsa-vpic-vin
description: Decode VINs via the public NHTSA vPIC API and list NHTSA safety recalls (plus owner-complaint summaries) for a vehicle's year/make/model, for Diag Desk diagnostics, shop ROs, and Ambrosia's Automotive workflows. Recalls are year/make/model-level, not VIN-confirmed — check nhtsa.gov/recalls with the VIN to confirm. Never invents API data.
